completed_tasks.name: softbm25-conceptnet
completed_tasks.description: Benchmark Phrase-Aware Soft-BM25 with ConceptNet Numberbatch embeddings to establish the word-vector family baseline
completed_tasks.reasoning: Hybrid search with MiniLM-L12 and grade-boost 2.0 leads the benchmark (NDCG@5=0.8058), but the word-vector family has no recorded runs on the leaderboard, and pure neural retrievers (CrossEncoder and ColBERT) exhibit a severe blind spot on dietary queries (C08 NDCG@5 ~0.33) because their indexed item texts omit dietary metadata. First, we benchmark Phrase-Aware Soft-BM25 with ConceptNet Numberbatch to establish baseline performance for the word-vector family. Second, we update crossencoder_search.py and colbert_search.py to incorporate item['dietary'] annotations into their text representations (matching hybrid_search.py), improving retrieval accuracy across dietary constraint categories.
